content.title: Energy Action Plan
content.summary: The City of Arvada launched its Energy Action Plan in 2022, in partnership with Xcel Energy, to promote energy efficiency and cost savings for residents and businesses. The plan provides resources for homeowners to improve energy efficiency, including the Home Energy Squad service, which offers personalized assessments and upgrades, as well as tips for reducing energy consumption and transitioning to renewable energy sources.
content.body:
## Energy Action in the City of Arvada

[The City of Arvada developed its first Energy Action Plan](/DocumentCenter/View/2360/Arvada-Energy-Action-Plan-Executive-Summary) in 2022 through collaboration with Xcel Energy’s Partners in Energy. This plan outlines strategies to help residents and businesses save money and resources.

Explore the residential programs below that help support the goals of this plan. Visit our [Energy Saving for Businesses page](/982) to learn about energy-saving opportunities for Arvada businesses.

## For Arvada Residents

Whether you are just getting started making your home efficient, or you are looking to make deeper, more impactful changes to lower your carbon footprint, there are a number of resources for you to consider. In general, it is best practice to follow this pathway as you decarbonize your home:

1. Plan for and take action on energy efficiency opportunities in your home, and consider electric heat pump technology when replacing equipment such as your furnace, AC, or water heater for even greater energy use reductions
2. Green your electricity supply through a green power purchase or by adding on-site solar panels to your home once you understand your long-term electricity use

### Energy Efficiency

One of the best ways to lower your energy bills and also reduce the cost of renewable energy for your home is to reduce the total energy you consume. Xcel Energy and other organizations have several resources to help you reduce the cost of upgrades in your home. Check out the energy-saving programs and rebates that Xcel Energy and other organizations offer!

### Starting Your Energy Efficiency Journey

Don’t know where to start on your energy efficiency journey? Sign up for a Home Energy Squad visit to get immediate savings and learn where else you can save! [Watch this video to learn what it's like to get a visit from the Home Energy Squad](https://youtu.be/lK4aCFZbiz0?feature=shared).

Ready to begin? Check out our residential energy efficiency guide below!

## Residential Energy Efficiency Guide

1. [First Step: A Home Energy Squad Visit](#tabbbee095a-2bb6-47ad-bdcd-d8e2af933749_0)

### Schedule a visit with the Home Energy Squad

The [Home Energy Squad](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/residential/home-services/home-energy-squad) is a team of energy experts that help you identify ways to save energy with a personalized home assessment. Plus, they do things like swap out traditional lightbulbs for LEDs, install a smart thermostat, weather-strip a drafty door, and install high-efficiency showerheads and faucet aerators. Choose from our in-home Squad or Squad Plus visit or sign up for a virtual visit to receive expert advice through video-chat and a DIY kit shipped to your door.

[Schedule your visit online](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/residential/home-services/home-energy-squad) or by calling 303-446-7910, option 2.

Eligibility requirements apply:

- You must be a residential customer of Xcel Energy in Colorado.
- Renters are eligible to participate in Home Energy Squad. Prior approval from the property owner/landlord is required.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2292)

1. [Next Steps: Energy Tips and LED lighting](#tabbbee095a-2bb6-47ad-bdcd-d8e2af933749_1)

If you have already taken advantage of Home Energy Squad and you’re looking for some other next steps to maintain your savings, consider these programs:

### Energy Saving Tips

Check out these [Energy Saving Tips](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/residential/tips) to help you quickly save energy and build habits that keep your home running efficiently. Follow these quick energy tips about heating and cooling, lighting, in the kitchen and laundry room savings to find easy ways to save.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2298)

### LED Lighting

LEDs, especially ENERGY STAR®-qualified products, use at least 75% less energy and last up to 25 times longer than the traditional incandescent bulbs they replace. Xcel Energy has teamed up with participating retailers to bring you special discounts. [Take advantage of the savings at Xcel Energy’s website](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/residential/home-rebates/home-lighting), or have your whole home retrofitted for free as part of a Home Energy Squad visit.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2300)

1. [Deeper Savings: HEating and Cooling Efficiency](#tabbbee095a-2bb6-47ad-bdcd-d8e2af933749_2)

If you have already taken advantage of Home Energy Squad and you’re looking for some other next steps to maintain your savings, consider these programs:

### [Insulation and Air Sealing](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/residential/home-rebates/insulation-air-sealing)

You could be wasting up to 20% of the energy used to heat and cool your home through air leakage and poor insulation. That's about the same amount of energy wasted as leaving a window wide open all year long. [Cash back rebates from Xcel Energy](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/residential/home-rebates/insulation-air-sealing) help with the initial cost of upgrades to improve and maintain the comfort of your home while also saving money over time when you use less energy to heat and cool your home.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2301)

### [Colorado Weatherization Assistance Program (WAP)](https://energyoffice.colorado.gov/weatherization-assistance-program)

Income qualified customers can receive energy and utility bill saving services at no cost through Colorado’s Weatherization Assistance Program. If you are a recipient of LEAP, SNAP, SSI or TANF, you automatically qualify. Explore energy efficiency solutions to start saving right away!

[Visit Colorado Energy Office website](https://energyoffice.colorado.gov/weatherization-assistance-program) to see if your household qualifies and for additional information on how to apply.

### [Heating and Cooling Efficiency](https://my.xcelenergy.com/s/residential/heating-cooling)

Heating and cooling your home can account for 50% of your energy bill. Xcel Energy can help you save through rebates for all-electric heat pumps, high efficiency air conditioning, and furnaces.

If your natural gas furnace is on its last legs, consider going electric! Upgrading to an air source heat pump (ASHP) delivers up to three times more heat than the electricity it consumes. You can receive up to $800 for upgrading your heating and cooling system to an ASHP. [To learn more about other heat pump rebate options, visit Xcel Energy’s website](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/residential/heating-cooling/heat-pumps).![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2302)

### [Water Heater Rebates](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/residential/home-rebates/water-heaters)

Water heaters are typically your second largest energy consumer in your home, consuming 18% of the energy you use. [Earn a rebate on a high-efficiency natural gas or electric water heater](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/residential/home-rebates/water-heaters) that can help you save energy and money.

Time to upgrade your water heater? All-electric heat pump hot water heaters (HPWH) can use 50% less energy and produce 77% fewer emissions compared to conventional gas-powered water tanks.![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2303)

## Renewable Energy

There are several renewable energy options to choose from, whether you are interested in on-site solar or purchasing renewable energy through a subscription. On-site solar may be right for you if you have already made energy efficient upgrades and your roof is not due for replacement soon. Subscription options may be right for you if you are not interested in investing in rooftop solar at this time, but still want to power your home renewably.

![Two adults and a child standing next to a solar panel ](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2312)

## On-Site Renewable Energy Programs

1. [Net Energy Metering](#taba7f45daa-7b37-43ef-806c-52c945d88b1d_0)
2. [Solar Rewards](#taba7f45daa-7b37-43ef-806c-52c945d88b1d_1)
3. [Battery Connect](#taba7f45daa-7b37-43ef-806c-52c945d88b1d_2)

1. [Net Energy Metering](#taba7f45daa-7b37-43ef-806c-52c945d88b1d_0)

Install on-site solar and offset your energy use by selling back the excess electricity generated from your solar system to the electrical grid.

[Learn more about Net Energy Metering](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/renewable/net-metering)

1. [Solar Rewards](#taba7f45daa-7b37-43ef-806c-52c945d88b1d_1)

Install on-site solar and offset your energy use by selling back the excess electricity generated from your solar system to the electrical grid, plus receive an additional $0.005/kWh - .0375/kWh produced.

[Learn more about Solar Rewards](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/renewable/solar-rewards)

1. [Battery Connect](#taba7f45daa-7b37-43ef-806c-52c945d88b1d_2)

Earn $1,250 for enrolling your battery storage in an Xcel Energy resiliency program.

[Learn more about Battery Connect](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/renewable/battery-connect)

## Subscription-Based Renewable Energy Programs

1. [Renewable Connect](#tab0f66d1a0-09f1-4135-96b7-8addb20b6463_0)
2. [Renewable Connect Flex](#tab0f66d1a0-09f1-4135-96b7-8addb20b6463_1)
3. [Solar Rewards Community](#tab0f66d1a0-09f1-4135-96b7-8addb20b6463_2)

1. [Renewable Connect](#tab0f66d1a0-09f1-4135-96b7-8addb20b6463_0)

Access renewable energy for your home at a low cost with more price certainty. This program is designed to offer flexible terms and subscription levels with easy enrollment and no equipment installation required.

[Learn more about Renewable Connect](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/renewable/renewable-connect)

1. [Renewable Connect Flex](#tab0f66d1a0-09f1-4135-96b7-8addb20b6463_1)

Convenient way to power your home with wind and solar energy. Terms are month-to-month, and you decide how much energy to enroll in. The Colorado program premium is $1.00 per 100 kWh block ($0.01 per kWh). This cost is in addition to your current electric charges. The average home uses between 7 and 10 blocks per month.

[Learn more about Renewable Connect Flex](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/renewable/renewable-connect)

1. [Solar Rewards Community](#tab0f66d1a0-09f1-4135-96b7-8addb20b6463_2)

Add more renewable energy to your community by supporting the development of nearby solar gardens without the hassle of installing solar panels on your home. Once subscribed, customers will begin receiving credits on their monthly electric bill for the solar energy and the Renewable Energy Credits that their subscription contributes to the Xcel Energy grid.

[Learn more about Solar Rewards Community](https://co.my.xcelenergy.com/s/renewable/solar-rewards-community)
